name: Skål Bar
author: Outcrop Labs
description: Omarchy status bar with Bartender-style hidden widget drawers, Noctalia-style appearance customization, a native system tray, and a settings GUI

barWidget.description: Logo launcher with the quick action panel

schema.label: Logo
schema.description: Text or icon glyph shown in the bar (e.g. 󰣇, Skål). Empty = default Omarchy mark.

schema.label: Logo font family
schema.description: Font family for the logo glyph (e.g. Symbols Nerd Font, monospace).

schema.label: Logo image
schema.description: Image file shown instead of text (~/.config/omarchy/logo.png).

schema.label: Logo color
schema.description: Hex color override for the logo (#rrggbb), or a theme token. Empty = bar foreground.
